title: Halloween
description: After being committed for 15 years, Michael Myers escapes from the mental institution and immediately returns to Haddonfield to find his baby sister, Laurie.

title: Halloween II
description: Laurie Strode struggles to come to terms with her brother Michael's deadly return to Haddonfield, Illinois; meanwhile, Michael prepares for another reunion with his sister.

title: The Lords of Salem
description: A radio DJ (Sheri Moon Zombie) in Salem, Mass., is plagued by nightmarish visions of vengeful witches after she plays a record by a mysterious group known only as "The Lords."

title: House of 1000 Corpses
description: Four travelers take refuge in the home of a clan of demented killers. Written and directed by musician Rob Zombie.

title: The Devil's Rejects
description: A vengeful sheriff and two bounty hunters track a murderous family (Sid Haig, Bill Moseley, Sheri Moon Zombie) on the run.

title: 3 From Hell
description: Crazed killers Baby Firefly, Captain Spaulding and Otis Driftwood unleash bloody mayhem after escaping from prison.

title: Escape Room
description: To celebrate his 30th birthday, Tyler and his six friends try an escape room challenge. The special mission for escaping a room in one hour starts, and the members immediately notice that the challenge is deadly and difficult.

title: Escape Plan
description: An expert (Sylvester Stallone) in prison security joins forces with an inmate (Arnold Schwarzenegger) to break out of a top-secret, high-tech facility.

title: Escape Plan 2: Hades
description: Security specialist Ray Breslin assembles an elite team to help him track down his trusted operative, Shu Ren, who has disappeared inside the most elaborate prison ever built.

title: Escape Plan: The Extractors
description: Ray Breslin and his team of security experts fight to rescue Breslin's girlfriend and a tech mogul's daughter from a formidable prison known as Devil's Station.

title: Cell
description: A graphic novelist (John Cusack) begins a desperate search for his estranged wife (Clark Sarullo) and son (Ethan Andrew Casto) after a mysterious cellphone signal transforms New Englanders into savage killers.

title: The Mist
description: Trapped townspeople (Thomas Jane, Marcia Gay Harden, Laurie Holden) face monsters inside and out after a supernatural fog engulfs their Maine community.

title: The Crazies
description: A lawman (Timothy Olyphant) and his wife (Radha Mitchell) and two companions fight to make it out of town alive after an unknown toxin turns ordinary citizens into bloodthirsty lunatics.

title: Cabin Fever
description: College students (Jordan Ladd, James DeBello, Rider Strong) fall prey to a flesh-eating virus after they head to the woods for a vacation.

description: As students prepare for their high school prom, they have no idea a flesh-eating virus is spreading via a popular brand of water.
